## Description

Describe your changes and the rationale behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`ruff check .`, `black --check .`).
- [ ] I have followed the TDD (Red-Green-Refactor) loop and added tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed (`pytest`).
